description: This file defines the AttendanceRepository class, which manages attendance data by interfacing with remote APIs, local database, and preferences. It provides methods to fetch today's attendance, mark attendance records, and synchronize pending records.

classes.name: AttendanceRepository
classes.description: Repository class responsible for managing attendance data, both local and remote, including fetching today’s records, marking attendance, and syncing pending records.

methods.name: today
methods.description: Fetches attendance records for today from the remote API if token is available.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Creates a new attendance record and attempts to save it locally and remotely, handling offline scenarios.

methods.name: syncPending
methods.description: Syncs all pending attendance records with the remote API.
